messages.content: Ananya nag
ananya nag... love the alliteration. where you working these days?
Texas instruments
texas instruments... the chip giant that's been around since calculators were cool. found you on linkedin - ananya nag, electrical engineer. this you? https://www.linkedin.com/in/nagananya
Hey

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
No, basically i work for compass group

ah compass group, not TI... my bad. found another ananya nag - graduate trainee at juniper networks. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/ananya-nag-519951241

or am i still off? might need you to drop your linkedin url directly if i keep missing
Yes

graduate trainee at juniper networks... networking gear, enterprise solutions, the works. solid tech company that actually pays well. what made you pick the trainee route over jumping straight into a full role?
Assistant cafe manager

wait hold up... assistant cafe manager at compass group? so you're in food services, not tech? that's a plot twist. 

compass group does corporate catering, right? and you've got a linkedin showing graduate trainee at juniper networks... what's the real story here? are you transitioning between roles or did linkedin get mixed up?

I'm more into hospitality sector
  Yes
  Yeah yeah

got it... so you're in hospitality, working as assistant cafe manager at compass group. that's corporate food service at scale - feeding office buildings, managing operations, dealing with everything from supply chains to hangry employees at 3pm.

hospitality's interesting... it's one of those industries where you actually see immediate impact of your work. people eat, they're happy (or they complain). no hiding behind dashboards and metrics.

how long you been working total? across all your roles?
3 months
10-11 hours

wait... 10-11 hours? lol that's like a day and a half of work total

i think you misunderstood - i meant how many months or years have you been working? like total work experience across all jobs, not how many hours you put in this week 😅

so how long have you actually been in the workforce?

ah 3 months... so you're fresh in the game! that makes way more sense than 10 hours lmaooo

3 months as assistant cafe manager at compass group - that's actually decent experience for someone starting out. you're learning operations, managing people, dealing with vendors, handling the chaos of feeding hundreds of people daily.

what kind of role you looking for next? staying in hospitality or thinking of exploring other areas?
Stay there

cool, sticking with what you know. hospitality's got good growth potential - you can move from assistant manager to manager to operations head, maybe even regional roles eventually.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities? hospitality's usually location-based but some corporate roles might have flexibility
Blr only
got it. so 3 months experience + hospitality focus + bangalore only... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
